summary: The change implements JSON.isRawJSON per spec. Step 1 checks that the argument is an Object and that it has the [[IsRawJSON]] slot, via `agent.native::<RawJsonData>(obj).is_some()`, and returns true. Step 2 returns false. Errors are not swallowed and nothing is hardcoded or special-cased. The diff touches only the target file. The gate reports build and clippy ok and two new passing test262 runs with no regressions. I could not compile or run anything, so the `agent.native` helper and `raw_json::RawJsonData` are taken from the diff and gate report, not checked against their definitions.
